layer1.name: Outbox
layer1.one_liner: Postal mail digitised: they collected your physical mail and scanned it for you.
layer1.description: Subscribers redirected their postal mail to the service, which collected, scanned and delivered it digitally, with the option to have originals kept or shredded. $4.99/month.
layer1.outcome_note: Shut down after the operational cost of physically collecting mail proved unsustainable and the postal service declined to cooperate. Loved by its users; the economics and a required partner both failed.
